narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Risk-Off
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multiple geopolitical flashpoints (Iran-US kinetic exchange, Israel two-front war, Ukraine deep strikes) escalate simultaneously. The market consensus underestimates the persistence and breadth of these conflicts, driving flows into safe havens and commodities.
narratives.trade_implication: Short S&P 500 futures, long WTI crude oil and gold; hedge with long-dated US Treasuries.

narratives.title: Oil Supply Disruption Premium
narratives.summary: Capital is pricing in a sustained oil supply disruption from the Strait of Hormuz blockade, with EIA forecasts showing persistence through Q3 2026. The SPR release is misread as bearish but actually signals government concern, and diplomatic progress is fragile, keeping crude bid.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude oil futures and Brent spreads; consider long-dated oil call options.

narratives.title: Crypto as Macro Risk Proxy
narratives.summary: Bitcoin's crash is driven by macro risk-off sentiment, not crypto-specific fundamentals, as institutional de-risking and geopolitical uncertainty dominate. Whale accumulation and MSTR buying provide a floor, but capital flows remain tied to broader risk appetite.
narratives.trade_implication: Short Bitcoin futures or buy put spreads; wait for geopolitical de-escalation before re-entering long.
